transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, what brought me in is... I just keep forgetting things at work. I do maintenance, and lately I keep missing scheduled callbacks, losing track of work orders, and just forgetting basic follow-ups I promised people. 

It's, uh, it's piled up so much that my job actually sent me here. I have a shot at moving up, and I really need to get this sorted out before I lose that chance.
Have you struggled with these types of memory and organizational issues your entire life, or is this a relatively new problem for you?

No, it's... it's definitely not a new problem. It's been my whole life, really. I remember being this way way back in grade school, long before I had any of this job pressure to deal with. 

My teachers always used to say I was a bright kid, but... I was just constantly misplacing my papers. I'd miss parts of the directions they gave us, and they always had to give me reminders just to finish my regular classwork. So, yeah, it's always been there.
